# Cocosol Surf Lessons

> Surf school in Cocoa Beach, Florida offering private, group, kids and coaching
> surf lessons, plus multi-day surf camps and packages. Certified local
> instructors, small groups, all gear included, beginner-friendly waves near
> Cocoa Beach Pier. Rated 4.9/5 from 90 reviews. Open daily 9:00-17:00.

## Lessons & Services
- [Private Surf Lessons](https://cocosolsurf.com/private-surf-lessons-cocoa-beach): 1-on-1 coaching with a dedicated certified instructor, all levels. From $75/person. Packs: 4-pack $260, 6-pack $475.
- [Group Surf Lessons](https://cocosolsurf.com/group-surf-lessons-cocoa-beach): Up to 4 students per instructor. $60/person. All gear included.
- [Kids Surf Lessons](https://cocosolsurf.com/kids-surf-lessons-cocoa-beach): Ages 6–16, ocean-safety-first, certified instructors. $60/person (group), $75/person (private).
- [Surf Coaching](https://cocosolsurf.com/surf-coaching-cocoa-beach): Video analysis and technique refinement for intermediate and advanced surfers. $75/person.
- [Surf Camp](https://cocosolsurf.com/surf-camp-cocoa-beach): Weekly surf camp Cocoa Beach (Mon–Fri). 1 child $350/week; 2 children $650/week; 3 children $900/week.
- [Surf Packages](https://cocosolsurf.com/surf-packages-cocoa-beach): Starter $260 (4 sessions), Progression $475 (6 sessions), Elite $1,280.

## Blog
- [Beginner's Guide to Surfing](https://cocosolsurf.com/blog/beginners-guide-to-surfing): What to expect, how to stand up, what to wear, choosing a lesson type.
- [Is Cocoa Beach Good for Surfing?](https://cocosolsurf.com/blog/is-cocoa-beach-good-for-surfing): Conditions, seasons and what to expect for surfers.
- [Surfing Near Orlando](https://cocosolsurf.com/blog/surfing-near-orlando): Planning a surf trip to the coast from Orlando.
- [Watch a Rocket Launch from Cocoa Beach](https://cocosolsurf.com/blog/watch-rocket-launch-cocoa-beach): Launch viewing spots, tracking the schedule, scrubs, and fitting a surf lesson around liftoff.
